auto_story.headline: HT: France shifts gears — progressive passing increased by 11 in 2nd half
auto_story.twitter_hook: France went in at the break trailing 0-2. The second half looked very different...
twitter_thread: 1/ In the first half, France managed 40 progressive passes. They went into the break trailing 0-2.
2/ In the second half they generated 51 — a 11-pass surge.
3/ Behind at the break, some of that is simply a team chasing the game. The scoreline is part of the explanation; the numbers show the surge, not the instruction behind it.

metrics.verdict_label: The momentum story is clear. France's progressive passing surged by 9 between halves — from 14 in the first half to 23 in the second. Argentina shifted by +4 in comparison. The half-time tactical adjustment was the defining moment of this match.
